items.quote: Peers observed that Darko Queneth managed presentations to senior management for her unit.
Direct reports said that Darko Queneth participated in an end-to-end review of the service ecosystem as a team member.
Direct reports said that Darko Queneth assisted with incident management during the ransomware attack.
She took ownership of community engagement on the estate renewal plan and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Darko delivered her share of adoption of new technology tools for case officers reliably.
Several respondents noted that Darko Queneth took ownership of cross-agency collaboration on the joint taskforce and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Darko managed evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes for her unit.
